name: Ethereal Neon-Bismuth Origami
description: A hyper-dimensional realm where geometric crystal shards, reminiscent of bismuth hopper crystals, continuously fold and unfold like ethereal neon origami floating in a dark expanse. Each cube facet carries concentric hopper stair-steps, recesses between shards are occluded and thin-film oxide thins inside them; bass breathes the unfold and treble lifts the crease neon.

params.name: Scale
params.description: Initial spacing of the fractal folds

params.name: Bloom Strength
params.description: The intensity of the unfolding effect when the mouse is near

params.name: Iridescence Rate
params.description: How rapidly the colors cycle across the viewing angles
